questions.question: In Screening Problem 2 ($O$ circle center, $A$ fixed interior point with $0 < OA < R$), when is $\angle OPA$ maximized?

options.text: When $PA$ is tangent to the circle

questions.explanation: By the Law of Sines, $\sin\angle OPA = \frac{OA}{R}\sin\angle OAP$, which is maximized (since $\angle OPA < 90^\circ$) when $\sin\angle OAP = 1$, i.e. $PA \perp OA$.

questions.question: In Screening Problem 10 ($f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ with IVP and $f^n(x) = -x$), which functions work?

options.text: $f(x) = -x$ when $n$ is odd; no solutions when $n$ is even

questions.explanation: A bijective IVP function is continuous and strictly monotonic, so $f^{2k}$ is strictly increasing and can never equal $-x$ when $n$ is even; for odd $n$, $f^2(x)=x$ forces $f(x)=-x$.

questions.question: What is the remainder when $\prod_{i=1}^{2016} (i^4 + 5)$ is divided by $2017$ (Screening Problem 16)?
questions.explanation: The $4$th powers form the order-$504$ subgroup, giving $(5^{504} - 1)^4$. Since $(5/2017) = -1$, $w = 5^{504}$ obeys $w^2 \equiv -1$, and $(w - 1)^4 = 4w^2 \equiv -4 \equiv 2013 \pmod{2017}$.

questions.question: In Screening Problem 18 (the 6-vertex rumor graph with white nodes $0, 1$ of degrees $3, 2$ and total degree sum $16$), what is the probability the process ends all-white?
questions.explanation: Because $\sum_{v} \deg(v) X_v(t)$ is a martingale, the absorption probability equals $(\deg(0)+\deg(1))/(2|E|) = (3+2)/16 = 5/16$.
